The '''Herglic Crush''' was an event that occurred in [[14,743 BBY]] at the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] celestial body [[Tomo-Reth]] and shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The event brought about the destruction of the [[Caliginous Automaton of Tomo-Reth]], a publicly displayed, [[Fire/Legends|fire]]-breathing [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that sat on a brick [[Throne/Legends|throne]] and was more than fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Herglic Crush was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
